notes.title: Goi Playtest Update #3

notes.title: Goi Playtest Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43444234/3d47724056d3e32fa1685d419cb142bdf8e18f6f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Here's what we updated [/h1]
- Items added to Granny shop
- Minor bugs fixed

[h1]Here are the tips[/h1]
- Exit Steam and re-enter to find the updated content
- Marble packs are [b]FREE [/b]of charge.
Please feel free to purchase them.  Notice the 'sandbox' note in Steam overlay?  That means you will NOT be charged for purchasing it.
- Granny is now selling items.  They can be purchased with either coins or marbles.  Choose wisely since your coins are limited... BUT wait for the next update to get more coin in your pocket!

Enjoy!
